subject.title: feat: let plugins control inbound debounce policy

question: Should OpenClaw expose `inbound_debounce` as a general plugin SDK hook, or keep the capability as a bounded WhatsApp-owned configuration surface represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100970?
rationale: Either choice establishes a long-lived public contract with different ownership, extensibility, and upgrade obligations; source review cannot safely choose the product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the generic plugin hook
options.body: Sponsor this PR’s SDK contract, define its supported channel scope and compatibility promise, then require real WhatsApp proof before merging.

options.title: Prefer WhatsApp-owned configuration
options.body: Decline the new SDK hook and pursue the narrower per-conversation WhatsApp configuration direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100970.

options.title: Defer both contracts
options.body: Keep both proposals open until a maintainer has a broader cross-channel batching design to sponsor.

recommendation.title: Prefer WhatsApp-owned configuration
recommendation.body: Decline the new SDK hook and pursue the narrower per-conversation WhatsApp configuration direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100970.

likelyOwner.reason: `mcaxtr` is the visible member reviewer who acknowledged this PR and is best positioned among the available evidence to route the contract choice.
